issue: Synthetic instructional labels are not bank ground truth
evidence: label_provenance states that course operating labels are instructor-created synthetic labels
impact: Model-label agreement would demonstrate consistency with the course labeling scheme rather than real bank operational correctness
control_or_limitation: Treat labels as instructional reference labels and do not claim real-world bank accuracy

evidence: Within the 653-case scoped cohort: Clear=401, Judgment Required=237, Insufficient Evidence=15
impact: Ambiguous cases reduce confidence in deterministic evaluation and increase disagreement risk
control_or_limitation: Keep label status visible and treat Judgment Required and Insufficient Evidence cases as limitations

evidence: fraud_indicator is strongly associated with routing_destination; escalation_required is structurally associated with human_review_required
impact: Including these fields as predictive inputs could produce artificially strong evaluation results
control_or_limitation: Exclude target/reference fields from predictive input and enforce the schema boundary

issue: No Low-urgency cases in scoped cohort
evidence: Urgency distribution: Low=0, Medium=381, High=171, Critical=101
impact: The dataset does not provide evidence for model behavior on Low-urgency cases
control_or_limitation: Treat urgency coverage as a known evaluation limitation

issue: sub_product and sub_issue completely missing in scoped cohort
impact: Analysis and routing evaluation cannot rely on these dimensions within the scoped cohort
control_or_limitation: Do not use these fields as required evidence for the bounded PoC
